SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_focused_alpha_leaders
FROM funds f
JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
JOIN (
    SELECT instrumentref, MAX(holdingpct) AS top_holding_weight
    FROM holdings
    GROUP BY instrumentref
) h ON h.instrumentref = f.tickersym
WHERE r.alpha5y > 0
  AND h.top_holding_weight > 0.08

WITH fund_amv AS (
    SELECT f.tickersym,
           ((r.avgreturn3y - p.benchr3y) / NULLIF(r.volatility3y, 0))
             - ((f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp) * 10) AS amv
    FROM funds f
    JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
    JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
    WHERE r.avgreturn3y IS NOT NULL
      AND p.benchr3y IS NOT NULL
      AND r.volatility3y IS NOT NULL
      AND f.expensenet IS NOT NULL
      AND f.benchmarkexp IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT tickersym,
       ROUND(amv::numeric, 4) AS amv,
       ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amv > 0) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM fund_amv)::numeric, 4)
         AS pct_funds_with_positive_amv
FROM fund_amv
WHERE amv IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY amv DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT f.productclass,
       COUNT(*) AS fund_count,
       ROUND(regr_slope(r.alpha3y, f.turnoverratio)::numeric, 4) AS alpha_turnover_slope,
       ROUND(regr_r2(r.alpha3y, f.turnoverratio)::numeric, 4) AS r_squared
FROM funds f
JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
WHERE r.alpha3y IS NOT NULL
  AND f.turnoverratio IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f.productclass
HAVING COUNT(*) > 25
ORDER BY regr_slope(r.alpha3y, f.turnoverratio) DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH cair AS (
    SELECT (((r.avgreturn3y - p.benchr3y) / NULLIF(r.volatility3y, 0))
            * (p.positiveyears / NULLIF(p.positiveyears + p.negativeyears, 0))) AS cair
    FROM funds f
    JOIN risk_metrics r ON r.investmentref = f.tickersym
    JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(cair)::numeric, 2) AS avg_consistency_adjusted_information_ratio
FROM cair

SELECT f.tickersym,
       f.shortlabel,
       ROUND((p.lowdelta / NULLIF(p.high52w - p.low52w, 0) * 100)::numeric, 8) AS price_position
FROM funds f
JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
WHERE (p.lowdelta / NULLIF(p.high52w - p.low52w, 0) * 100) < 25
  AND f.turnoverratio < 0.3
  AND (f.expensenet - f.benchmarkexp) < 0
ORDER BY price_position ASC
LIMIT 100

WITH hq AS (
    SELECT fundlink,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ratinglink IN (1, 2, 3) THEN allocationpct ELSE 0 END) AS high_quality_alloc
    FROM bond_allocations
    GROUP BY fundlink
), premier AS (
    SELECT f.tickersym,
           f.shortlabel,
           (f.yieldrate / NULLIF(f.expensenet, 0)) * hq.high_quality_alloc AS sies
    FROM funds f
    JOIN hq ON hq.fundlink = f.tickersym
    WHERE (f.yieldrate / NULLIF(f.expensenet, 0)) > 15
      AND hq.high_quality_alloc > 0.6
)
SELECT tickersym,
       shortlabel,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sies DESC) AS premier_rank,
       sies AS secure_income_efficiency_score
FROM premier
ORDER BY sies DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN f.pe_ratio IS NOT NULL AND f.pb_ratio IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'Transparent' ELSE 'Opaque' END AS valuation_data_availability,
       COUNT(*) AS fund_count,
       ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.r1y)::numeric, 4) AS median_1y_return
FROM funds f
LEFT JOIN performance p ON p.productref = f.tickersym
GROUP BY 1

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT ar.calendaryear,
           ar.fundperf - ar.categoryperf AS outperformance
    FROM annual_returns ar
    WHERE ar.portfolioref = 'AADR'
)
SELECT calendaryear,
       outperformance,
       LAG(outperformance) OVER (ORDER BY calendaryear) AS prev_year_outperformance,
       outperformance - LAG(outperformance) OVER (ORDER BY calendaryear) AS yoy_outperformance_change
FROM yearly
ORDER BY calendaryear
